Five merged PRs since 2026-04-14 added or removed a line containing `CriteriaBuilder` under `api/src/main/java/org/openmrs/api/db/hibernate` on the default branch, whose head is `0e0255b`. I checked the diff of each of the 22 main-line commits that touch that directory since that date. The other 17 add or remove no such line.

1. **#6088** (TRUNK-6635, LocationSearchCriteria search), merged 2026-05-18. It adds `CriteriaBuilder cb = session.getCriteriaBuilder();` to `getLocations(LocationSearchCriteria)`, now at `openmrs-core/api/src/main/java/org/openmrs/api/db/hibernate/HibernateLocationDAO.java:446`.
2. **#6079** (TRUNK-6633, ConceptSearchCriteria), merged 2026-06-01. It adds `getConcepts(ConceptSearchCriteria)` with a `CriteriaBuilder`, plus helper methods that take one as a parameter, in `openmrs-core/api/src/main/java/org/openmrs/api/db/hibernate/HibernateConceptDAO.java:1161-1206`.
3. **#6359** (TRUNK-6681, LocationSearchCriteria pagination), merged 2026-07-21. It refactors `getLocations` and adds `buildPredicates(CriteriaBuilder cb, ...)` at `openmrs-core/api/src/main/java/org/openmrs/api/db/hibernate/HibernateLocationDAO.java:476-477`.
4. **#6410** (TRUNK-6731, obs paging), merged 2026-08-20. The only match is an added Javadoc `{@link #createOrderList(CriteriaBuilder, Root, List)}` at `openmrs-core/api/src/main/java/org/openmrs/api/db/hibernate/HibernateObsDAO.java:192`. It is a literal match in documentation, not code.
5. **#6598** (TRUNK-6707, global property caching), merged 2026-10-01. It adds a `CriteriaBuilder` in the new `getStoredGlobalPropertyName` and removes one from `getGlobalPropertyObject`, at `openmrs-core/api/src/main/java/org/openmrs/api/db/hibernate/HibernateAdministrationDAO.java:130-146`.
